description: Verify a single citation string against real bibliographic databases (Crossref, OpenAlex, etc). Returns whether the citation is verified, mismatched, or looks hallucinated/fabricated, along with the real record's metadata when one is found. Use this to catch fake or incorrect references in a paper, essay, or LLM-generated text.

text.description: The citation string to verify, e.g. an APA/MLA formatted reference or a raw title+author string. Max 2000 characters.

name: verify_citation
